Dark goes to steal an artwork from the "haunted" Old Clover Mansion… which is where Riku lost the teddy-bear when she was younger, that it was later rescued by a boy. Risa also discovers a secret close to Dark's heart after Dark says she won't see him anymore. Riku figured out later that it is Daisuke who retrieved her precious thing, the teddy bear.

Episodes.Title: A Summer Without Dark
Episodes.Description: Daisuke's class goes on an excursion to a tropical island to watch the Milky Way. Takeshi is rather into Mio. Both Risa and Riku are increasingly attracted to Daisuke and a nature hike will determine which twin will end up with Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Two Under The Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Riku sprains her ankle after a fall and Daisuke carries her. Mio is playing psychic. Risa suspects Daisuke of being Dark, but decides he's not when she realizes he doesn't act like Dark, becoming more mature. Daisuke finally realizes his true feelings for Riku after clearing a misunderstanding, and the two watch beautiful shooting stars falling near the beach.

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Heroine
Episodes.Description: Daisuke has to create an artwork for the cultural festival. Satoshi discovers his father's, Kei Hiwatari, scheme to capture Dark. Risa uncovers secrets of the love between Dark and her grandmother Rika, in a letter hidden at the Harada mansion. Meanwhile, the boys in Daisuke's class are to be performing the play "Ice and Snow", with Daisuke and Satoshi filling the lead roles.

Episodes.Title: Because I Wanted To See You
Episodes.Description: Kosuke enlightens Daisuke with the story of "Ice and Snow". Daisuke completes his piece for the festival - a painting of a snowscape, where the shadows on the purest snow are blue instead of gray. Mio must make a very important decision. As Riku gives Daisuke the pendant of friendship instead of love, Mio sacrifices herself in the end.

Episodes.Title: An Icy Voice Calling
Episodes.Description: Daisuke is feeling ill. Satoshi warns Daisuke that something is up, then Kosuke has a friendly chat with Satoshi. At nightfall, Daisuke enters the world of his painting, led by an entity known as "The Second Hand of Time". Dark has to steal the painting left at the Harada's household in order to bring Daisuke back.

Episodes.Title: Ice and Snow
Episodes.Description: Dark enters the snowscape world of the painting with both of the Harada twins in order to search and rescue Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Second Hand of Time
Episodes.Description: Kosuke discovers the original edition of the story, entitled "Ice and Dark". Meanwhile, Daisuke meets a girl named Freedert who is one with the Second Hand of Time, waiting for her long lost lover - Elliott. Long ago, the two lovers were cursed due to a childhood friend's jealous. Dark goes in search of "The Wedge of Time" sword, a Hiwatari's family artwork which is the key to rescuing Daisuke and bringing the story to an end.

Episodes.Title: Snow Falls in The Heart
Episodes.Description: Dark battles Krad to retrieve the Wedge of Time as the Harada twins witness it all. Satoshi repaints Daisuke's painting to retrieve him. Freedert and Elliott are finally reunited. The story of Ice and Dark is completed as snow comes falling down upon the city.

Episodes.Title: The Black Wings
Episodes.Description: Once Christmas is approaching, the signs of a 40-year repeated disaster—an extreme low tide and an earthquake—prompt the city authorities to issue an evacuation. Riku worries about Daisuke and she eventually finds out about his and Dark's identity.

Episodes.Title: Eternal Dark
Episodes.Description: Once upon a time the Hiwatari family created a living artwork, known as The Black Wings. The Niwa family, a family of phantom thieves tried to steal the artwork. The artwork must now be sealed forever. Krad and Dark fight, and at the end they both are sealed into the Black Wings, from which they came from. The Harada twins help Mio to stop Kei. After Daisuke saves Satoshi from sacrificing his life, Daisuke clearly realize Riku is his sacred maiden and the two kiss, and Dark and Krad disappear peacefully.

Episodes.Description: Four high-school good-looking boys, Kyohei Takano, Takenaga Oda, Yukinojo Toyama, and Ranmaru Morii, have made a deal with their landlady, Mine Nakahara: if they succeeded in transforming her niece into a proper lady they can live in their home rent free, but if they fail the rent will triple. The niece, Sunako Nakahara, is poorly dressed with bad skin and no fashion sense; her bangs cover her eyes. She is also a heartbroken horror-fan who has spent two years as a recluse after being told she was ugly when she confessed to her middle-school crush.

Episodes.Title: Pull Down the Iron Curtain!
Episodes.Description: The boys try to cut Sunako's bangs, with no success. After Sunako accidentally walks in on Kyohei bathing, he jumps out of the window in surprise and catches a cold as a result. They do not know this until Sunako has to defend herself against a group of ganguro girls who try to cut off her bangs by force, due to their jealousy of her familiarity with Kyohei. Eventually, Kyohei saves Sunako, but he ends up with a fever. Sunako has to take care of him which she does not approve of, debating whether or not to kill him. As she attempts to, the other three boys walk in, and a black hole forms, pulling them in. The episode ends with Sunako screaming possession over Kyohei.

Episodes.Title: Ah, the Nostalgic Gloominess of Youth
Episodes.Description: Four men of the Japanese host club scene try to forcefully recruit Kyohei. Sunako doesn't think she can survive living around a bishōnen like Kyohei, as she plans to kill him. However, she has to save Kyohei from the recruiters who have kidnapped him for dubious purposes. Mine returns to invite everyone to a coming out party for Sunako, by which the boys have to make Sunako a lady as soon as possible.

Episodes.Title: Sunako, You're Needed
Episodes.Description: Sunako's class recruits her to make a haunted house for the school festival, only for Kyohei to realize that she was conned by the class president. Kyohei recruits the guys to help make her haunted house win the contest of the school festival so he can get the prize. They ultimately win the contest, however Kyohei is left to claim the prize, since the other three refused to accept it. Unfortunately, Kyohei is forced to pay for the damages caused by the explosion inflicted earlier.

Episodes.Title: Feast of the Beautiful Creatures
Episodes.Description: A picture of an angry Sunako from the festival catches the eye of an egotistic photographer who wants her to model for him. Although tricked into going to the shoot, a camera-shy Sunako proves a difficult subject. The four bishōnen are soon dragged into replacing Sunako in the modelling shoot, however they take leave with Sunako after the photographer explains the difficulty shooting Sunako. The five of them later go an exhibition of where a picture was discreetly taken of them, as it turns out that the photographer used that picture as the greatest attraction in the exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Seen in Dreams
Episodes.Description: When Sunako becomes ill, the four bishōnen is left with a household of chores. They unsuccessfully attempt to clean, by which they figure out, with the help of Noi, that Sunako misses Halloween, her favorite holiday. They later throw a Halloween party to cheer her up.

Episodes.Title: I Am No. 1
Episodes.Description: A leader of a gang falls in love with Sunako. Thinking that Kyohei is his rival, the leader of the gang challenges him to a fight declaring who deserves Sunako as their lover. When Kyohei becomes badly injured, Sunako steps in and defeats the leader of the gang, putting everyone in shock.

Episodes.Title: Winter Wonder Land
Episodes.Description: The boys wonder if they're taking advantage of Sunako's cooking, and get a job at a fancy restaurant in order to lessen her burden. Kyohei wishes to eat nabe at a kotatsu, as he has never experienced the winter tradition. Kyohei goes shopping with Sunako, only to have the entire marketplace misunderstand their relationship. To add thing up Kyohei's fangirls appears and play around their grocery. Kyohei later lends a shopkeeper a helping hand, in return for some vegetables. Meanwhile, Sunako goes out to construct a kotatsu. In the end, they end up having an enormous kotatsu feast.

Episodes.Title: Splashing Blood and Steam, Inside a Shower of Love Pt 1
Episodes.Description: The boys take Sunako, along with Noi, on a trip to the hot springs. Sunako tries to do everything she can do so that Takenaga and Noi can be alone, which leads to the fact that Kyohei and Sunako have a very intense ping-pong match. As the match ends, it is shown that Kyohei and Sunako share a kiss by accident.

Episodes.Title: Splashing Blood and Steam, Inside a Shower of Love Pt 2
Episodes.Description: The hot springs manager has been attacked, and Sunako decides that she cannot pass up the opportunity to snoop around a real crime scene. However, the true culprit resents not only Sunako snooping around, but also her being accompanied by the four bishōnen. It turns out that the wife of the manager is responsible, plotting to kill Sunako by burning her alive in the storage room, by which Kyohei is able to rescue her out of. When they confront the wife of the manager, who insults Sunako's appearance, Kyohei states they have kissed.

Episodes.Title: The Test and the Study Kiss
Episodes.Description: Sunako needs to be tutored in math, since failure to do so will cause the rent to increase. Kyohei dresses up as a nerd and studies hard to teach Sunako not to run away from her issues, however this causes an uproar among the female students. While doing so Sunako remembers the incident that she kissed a radiant being (Kyouhei) which causes her to react badly. Later Kyouhei makes her understand that a passion-less kiss is nothing. Unfortunately, Sunako still failed the exam due to putting the right answers in the wrong math problems.

Episodes.Title: Oh, my sweet home!
Episodes.Description: The four bishōnen think back to their first Christmas together, when they just moved in and how different they were back then. At the time, Takenaga, Yuki, and Ranmaru first met each other at the mansion a few years ago. It is revealed by Mine that the three of them came from rejected families. After causing a mess in the dining room, the three get into an argumentative fight. Mine later finds Kyohei and invites him in the mansion along with the others. They later receive phone calls and letters from female students searching for Kyohei. The three chip in to help drive out the females students, but to no avail. However, as Kyohei steps in, as well as with Mine's help, they resolve the issue with all the female students.

Episodes.Title: Oui, Monsieur!
Episodes.Description: Yuki receives a basket of mushrooms for free. Sunako eats one of these strange mushrooms and is magically transformed into a lady. Though things start to take a turn for the worse when Sunako is one. Then all the guys try to change her back by means of seduction.

Episodes.Title: The Beauty of the Sleeping Woods
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru receives a phone call from his father, who tells him that he is engaged to be married. Determined to break the engagement, the four bishōnen plot to make Ranmaru someone unworthy to be a husband. However, to no success, Ranmaru's fiancée, Tamao Kikunoi begins to take a liking to Ranmaru's imitative personalities. However, she begins to realize that Ranmaru has no interest in her. Feeling guilty, Ranmaru visits Tamao's school grounds to apologize, but he is raided by other girls Ranmaru has dated. It is later revealed that Tamao truly wants to marry him.

Episodes.Title: Pirates of the Tres Bien
Episodes.Description: Sunako and the others are invited to an island that has a history of pirates burying treasure there. Kyohei sets off to find treasure, while Sunako looks for skeletons. Then when Sunako finally finds what she's looking for, it starts to cause trouble for the guys. It is revealed that she is possessed by a spirit who activates traps sets throughout the island. Noi eventually arrives at the island, worried about Takenaga. However, the spirit causes Yuki, Ranmaru, Takenaga, and Noi to hallucinate, being possessed in the process, while Kyohei encounters the possessed Sunako. Sunako is about to release the spirit due to her love of the skeletons, returning everyone back to normal.

Episodes.Title: Dream Comes True
Episodes.Description: The high school holds a sports festival, and strangely Sunako and Kyohei are willingly participating. They become strongly competitive, going to extreme measures to beat one another. In the last round, after being so competitive, they end up participating for their own personal goals.

Episodes.Title: Girls Bravo!!
Episodes.Description: Tamao wants to feel loved by Ranmaru, even after knowing how many girls he has dated in the past. Noi suggests that she should spend the day at a beauty salon, bringing Tamao and an unwilling Sunako along. Meanwhile, Ranmaru and Takenaga have been bickering about the girls for the past few days. After spending time with Noi and Tamao, Sunako prepares a feast for them, showing that she cares about them. Later on, Ranmaru and Takenaga apologize to Noi and Tamao for their rude behavior.

Episodes.Title: Dream·Loving Each Other
Episodes.Description: The four bishōnen go to extreme measures to persuade Sunako into wearing a dress, by renovating the mansion in a scary appearance. However, when she goes to shop while wearing the dress, she is mistaken for taking a young boy hostage. With Noi's help, the boys rescue Sunako, causing a commotion in the process.

Episodes.Title: Battlechicks Valentine
Episodes.Description: On Valentine's Day the four bishōnen are bombarded with cards, gifts, and boxes of chocolates from a crowd of female students. The boys do all they can to escape the madness from the lovestruck girls. Meanwhile, Sunako seems to have an obsession with chocolate, going out of her way to acquire as much as she can.

Episodes.Title: Trial's Love
Episodes.Description: Kyohei becomes upset when he finds out that Sunako's anatomical mannequin, Hiroshi, is more important to her than he is. It is revealed that Sunako found Hiroshi in a dumpster during a downpour after she was insulted by her middle-school crush two years ago. When Kyohei goes to the convenience store, a group of female students steal Hiroshi. This later causes Sunako to panic, as she sets out to look for Hiroshi, but to no avail. She later finds Hiroshi stolen by the group of female students, as they demand to obtain Kyohei. Sunako refuses but Kyouhei goes in order to help Sunako. They become worried. Moments later, Kyohei is seen carrying Hiroshi with him, as he tells the others that the girls were satisfied just by serving him some tea, some sweets and seeing him bare-shirted.

Episodes.Title: Memory in Sepia
Episodes.Description: Sunako's father comes to visit Sunako after he hears a rumor that Kyohei was her lover. Sunako's father spends time with Kyohei, realizing that he is a good guy at heart. He then reminisces about when he defeated a bear for Sunako, after Kyohei saw his exposed scars on his back. It is revealed that Sunako's father fears scary objects, those found in Sunako's room.

Episodes.Title: The Prince in Sheep's Clothing
Episodes.Description: Kyohei is kidnapped by a bunch of crazy shopkeepers, however Sunako is accidentally kidnapped with him. Takenaga searches for suspicious areas, while Ranmaru brings Noi and Tamao to help find Sunako. Yuki is mistaken for one of the shopkeepers and is eventually taken to their hideout. Meanwhile, Sunako causes an uproar in the hideout, frightening the shopkeepers. It is revealed that the shopkeepers want Kyohei to return to the shopping district to save their businesses. Yuki is able to rescue Kyohei and meets up with the others. Sunako is shown residing in house of Kyohei's parents.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Typhoon, Returning Home
Episodes.Description: Kyohei returns to his home unwillingly to get Sunako back. They are forced to stay one night in the same room, to which Sunako refuses to sleep near him. Sunako talks with Kyohei's parents, getting a better understanding about their situation with Kyohei. Kyohei is later confronted by his mother, frustrated by the many girls that contact him. Sunako, sympathizing with Kyohei's mother, rids the house of any mirrors. However, Kyohei's mother tries to stop her from disposing of her cosmetics. Meanwhile, the others manage to drive off all the girls that were stalking Kyohei. As they depart, Kyohei wonders why Sunako does not want to be around him.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Typhoon, Straying
Episodes.Description: Kyohei is seen eating in various restaurants, as he chose to run away since Sunako does not want to be around him. However, it is revealed that Sunako seems more depressed than usual. The three boys, along with Sunako and Noi, try to convince Kyohei to come home via television broadcast. However, Mine becomes furious when she misunderstands Kyohei's position with Sunako.

Episodes.Title: Road to Womanhood
Episodes.Description: Mine comes and wreaks havoc, but luckily Sunako calms her down and teaches her how to be a good housewife. But when Sunako gets invited to her aunt's party, she has to try to brave the road to womanhood. In the end, Mine tells the boys to make Sunako a super lady.

Episodes.Description: Kyohei returns to his home unwillingly to get Sunako back. They are forced to stay one night in the same room, to which Sunako refuses to sleep near him. Sunako talks with Kyohei's parents, getting a better understanding about their situation with Kyohei. Kyohei is later confronted by his mother, frustrated by the many girls that contact him. Sunako, sympathizing with Kyohei's mother, rids the house of any mirrors. However, Kyohei's mother tries to stop her from disposing of her cosmetics. Meanwhile, the others manage to drive off all the girls that were stalking Kyohei. As they depart, Kyohei wonders why Sunako does not want to be around him.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Typhoon, Straying
Episodes.Description: Kyohei is seen eating in various restaurants, as he chose to run away since Sunako does not want to be around him. However, it is revealed that Sunako seems more depressed than usual. The three boys, along with Sunako and Noi, try to convince Kyohei to come home via television broadcast. However, Mine becomes furious when she misunderstands Kyohei's position with Sunako.

Episodes.Title: Road to Womanhood
Episodes.Description: Mine comes and wreaks havoc, but luckily Sunako calms her down and teaches her how to be a good housewife. But when Sunako gets invited to her aunt's party, she has to try to brave the road to womanhood. In the end, Mine tells the boys to make Sunako a super lady.

Entries.Title: Naruto Shippuden
Entries.Description: Set in an Alternate Universe from the main continuity, the OVA tells the story of Naruto and his misadventures at the high school he attends as a transfer student. From the first day, he swiftly establishes a fierce rivalry with Sasuke, picks fights with every person he can, and fends off gangsters who would seek to defeat him. The story also outlines the three girls' reactions to Naruto's antics, as well as teasing the famous NaruHina ship somewhat.

Episodes.Title: Picture Drama: Shippuu! Konoha High (Special)
Episodes.Description: Set in an Alternate Universe from the main continuity, the OVA tells the story of Naruto and his misadventures at the high school he attends as a transfer student. From the first day, he swiftly establishes a fierce rivalry with Sasuke, picks fights with every person he can, and fends off gangsters who would seek to defeat him. The story also outlines the three girls' reactions to Naruto's antics, as well as teasing the famous NaruHina ship somewhat.

Episodes.Title: Naruto x Uniqlo (Special)
Episodes.Description: UNIQLO clothing stores throughout Japan will be offering a Naruto x UT Original DVD with all-new animation on January 1. The DVD will contain an original Naruto anime video set to an exclusive version of Mayonaka no Orchestra, the upcoming song by the Japanese rock band Aqua Timez. A limited number of the DVDs will be offered as presents to people who buy UNIQLO's Naruto graphic T-shirts online or in stores.

Episodes.Title: Sunny Side Battle! (Special)
Episodes.Description: A comedy-filled filler with a plot revolving around the two Uchiha Brothers, Mangekyo Sharingan, chickens, and fried eggs.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: A figure passes through the gates. It's an older Naruto, who has returned from a long training journey with Jiraiya. Naruto Uzumaki is back!

Episodes.Title: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sakura team up and challenge Kakashi to a survival challenge to show off their progress.

Episodes.Title: The Results of Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto’s and Sakura’s combined skills force Kakashi to use his Sharingan right off the bat. Naruto masterfully unleashes his jutsu one after another.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Sand
Episodes.Description: Gaara is quick to detect Deidara’s presence, and an aerial battle ensues with Deidara on his giant bird and Gaara atop sand.

Episodes.Title: The Kazekage Stands Tall
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sakura defeat Kakashi in the survival challenge. Tsunade assigns them to a three-man squad led by Kakashi, who tells them they are now his equals.

Episodes.Title: Mission Cleared
Episodes.Description: In order to protect his village from Deidara’s explosive clay, Gaara uses his chakra to create a giant sand shield.

Episodes.Title: Run, Kankuro
Episodes.Description: Gaara, his strength completely exhausted, is whisked away by Deidara. Kankuro ignores Baki’s efforts to stop him and immediately sets out in pursuit with a platoon to rescue Gaara.

Episodes.Title: Team Kakashi, Deployed
Episodes.Description: An urgent message from the Sand Village detailing the Akatsuki’s kidnapping of the Kazekage reaches the Hidden Leaf Village. Tsunade wastes no time in ordering Team Kakashi to the Sand Village.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Tears
Episodes.Description: On her way to the Sand Village, Temari encounters Kakashi and his team. Kakashi admonishes Naruto when he tries to rush ahead…

Episodes.Title: Sealing Jutsu: Nine Phantom Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Sand ninja fight against time to treat Kankuro. Even the Sand’s poison expert, Granny Chiyo, is baffled. The only hope lies with the reinforcements sent by Tsunade.

Episodes.Title: The Medical Ninja's Student
Episodes.Description: Sakura treats a critically ill Kankuro. After extensive training she’s now a full-fledged Medic Ninja, and Sakura amazes everyone with her sure, steady hands.

Episodes.Title: The Retired Granny's Determination
Episodes.Description: Pakkun finds the hideout of the Akatsuki. Team Kakashi and Temari prepare to set out to get Gaara back, but Temari is ordered to stay behind and help guard the village.

Episodes.Title: A Meeting With Destiny
Episodes.Description: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

Episodes.Title: Naruto's Growth
Episodes.Description: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Weapon is Called...
Episodes.Description: Granny Chiyo and Sakura rescue Naruto from Itachi’s genjutsu. Without a moment’s delay, Kakashi begins a counterattack.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Jinchuriki
Episodes.Description: Chiyo and Kakashi realize that the attack was just a diversion, and that the Akatsuki have already begun the process of extracting the Tailed Beast from Gaara.

Episodes.Title: The Death of Gaara!
Episodes.Description: Teams Kakashi and Guy take a short rest. Granny Chiyo watches Naruto dozing off and is reminded of Sasori as a child. The pursuit resumes, and when Chiyo wonders why Naruto puts such effort into...

Episodes.Title: Charge Tactic! Button Hook Entry!!
Episodes.Description: Teams Kakashi and Guy reach the Akatsuki hideout. They hurry to infiltrate but are thwarted by a five-seal barrier. The only way to break the barrier is to remove all five seals at once.

Episodes.Title: Traps Activate! Team Guy's Enemy
Episodes.Description: Breaking the five-seal barrier set off a trap, which now has Team Guy battling amazingly accurate copies of themselves. Back at the Akatsuki hideout, Deidara and Sasori struggle to take the Nine-Tail Jinchûriki.

Episodes.Title: Hiruko Vs. Two Kunoichi!
Episodes.Description: At last, the showdown between the old woman and her grandson begins. Sakura is confused by Sasori’s strange appearance, and Granny Chiyo explains that this is Hiruko…

Episodes.Title: Sasori's Real Face
Episodes.Description: Granny Chiyo and Sakura manage to expose Sasori, who amazingly looks no older than he did twenty years earlier.

Episodes.Title: Chiyo's Secret Skills
Episodes.Description: Sakura is caught by Sasori’s tactic and surrounded by a poison cloud.

Episodes.Title: Father and Mother
Episodes.Description: Chiyo and Sakura take cover, and Sasori wastes no time unleashing a ruthless attack.

Episodes.Title: The Third Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Sakura counters the Iron Sand attack of the Third Kazekage puppet with superhuman strength.

Episodes.Title: Three Minutes Between Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Sakura destroys the Third Kazekage puppet thanks to a secret antidote she had taken.

Episodes.Title: Puppet Fight: 10 vs. 100!
Episodes.Description: Sakura and Granny Chiyo are engaged in a fierce battle with Sasori, who is able turn himself into a human puppet. They somehow bring Sasori down within the time limit, but he ends up reviving.

Episodes.Title: Impossible Dream
Episodes.Description: Although stung with poison herself, Granny Chiyo uses the last of the antidote on Sakura. Mocking the tender scene between Granny Chiyo and Sakura, Sasori attempts to end Granny Chiyo's life.

Episodes.Title: Revival of the Beasts
Episodes.Description: Team Guy senses the result of the Sakura and Granny Chiyo’s desperate struggle while still in battle with his deadly copy. Although Guy’s team members are showing fatigue, their copies remain strong!

Episodes.Title: Kakashi's Enlightened!
Episodes.Description: Sakura hurries to get to Naruto with Granny Chiyo, who is suffering from the poison. The members of Team Guy rush to assist Team Kakashi. Meanwhile, with all preparations complete, Kakashi reveals his Mangekyo Sharingan.

Episodes.Title: Aesthetics of an Instant
Episodes.Description: Naruto loses all reason to anger and is gradually taken over by the Nine-Tailed Fox Spirit. Having been forewarned by Jiraiya, Kakashi narrowly manages to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox.

Episodes.Title: The Legacy
Episodes.Description: Relying on Naruto's power, Granny Chiyo performs the Transmigration Jutsu on Gaara.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Gaara and his rescuers make a triumphant return to the Hidden Sand Village.

Episodes.Title: The New Target
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Team Kakashi gets a new member, Sai. They are sent on a mission to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Formation! New Team Kakashi
Episodes.Description: Sai is a mysterious ninja who has no emotions. He is a member of Root, a secret organization within the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: An Unnecessary Addition
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sai do not get along. They are constantly fighting.

Episodes.Title: The Fake Smile
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi sets out on their mission. They are led by Yamato, a ninja who can control wood.

Episodes.Title: Untitled
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi arrives at the Tenchi Bridge, where they are supposed to meet one of Sasori's spies.

Episodes.Title: The Fruits of Training
Episodes.Description: The spy turns out to be Kabuto, Orochimaru's right-hand man. Orochimaru appears and a battle ensues.

Episodes.Title: The Nine-Tails Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Naruto loses control and unleashes the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox. He grows four tails and becomes a miniature version of the beast.

Episodes.Title: The Top-Secret Mission Begins
Episodes.Description: Yamato uses his wood style to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. Naruto returns to normal, but he is badly injured.

Episodes.Title: Orochimaru's Hideout
Episodes.Description: Sai reveals that he has been working for Danzo, a rogue elder of the Hidden Leaf Village. He has been ordered to kill Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Bond
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi infiltrates Orochimaru's hideout. They are determined to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Sakura's Tears
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi finds Sasuke, but he is not the same person they once knew. He is cold and distant.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Battle
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks Team Kakashi. He is more powerful than ever before.

Episodes.Title: The Consequences of Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke face off. Their battle is interrupted by Orochimaru and Kabuto.

Episodes.Title: The Unfinished Page
Episodes.Description: Sai has a change of heart and decides to help Team Kakashi. He wants to understand the meaning of friendship.

Episodes.Title: Infiltration! The Den of the Snake!
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi returns to the Hidden Leaf Village. Their mission was a failure, but they have not given up on Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Bonds
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Naruto begins his training to create a new jutsu. He must learn to combine his wind chakra with the Rasengan.

Episodes.Title: Something Important...
Episodes.Description: Asuma Sarutobi, the leader of Team 10, is killed by Hidan, a member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Picture Book's Story
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru is devastated by Asuma's death. He vows to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Team 10, led by Kakashi, goes after Hidan and Kakuzu, another member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Power of the Uchiha
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru uses his intelligence to defeat Hidan. He traps him in a pit and buries him alive.

Episodes.Title: Title
Episodes.Description: Naruto arrives to help Kakashi fight Kakuzu. He has perfected his new jutsu, the Rasenshuriken.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Kakuzu with his Rasenshuriken. The jutsu is powerful, but it also damages Naruto's arm.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The Akatsuki's leader, Pain, begins his plan to capture the Nine-Tailed Fox.

Episodes.Title: Writhe
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village to gather information on Pain. He is confronted by Konan, a former student.

Episodes.Title: Deprived of Sleep
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya faces off against Pain. Pain has the Rinnegan, a powerful dojutsu that was once possessed by the Sage of Six Paths.

Episodes.Title: Loneliness
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya is killed by Pain. He dies with a smile on his face, knowing that he has found the child of prophecy.

Episodes.Title: A New Enemy
Episodes.Description: Pain attacks the Hidden Leaf Village. He is looking for Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Description: The ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village fight back against Pain. They are no match for his power.

Episodes.Title: The Forbidden Jutsu
Episodes.Description: Kakashi is killed by Pain. He dies protecting the village.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Naruto returns to the village and finds it in ruins. He is devastated by the destruction.

Episodes.Title: The Triumphant Return
Episodes.Description: Naruto faces off against Pain. He has mastered Sage Mode, a powerful technique that allows him to use natural energy.

Episodes.Title: The Sixth Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Pain and saves the village. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage Summit
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The leaders of the five great ninja villages meet to discuss the threat of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Man Named Kisame
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks the Five Kage Summit. He is looking for Danzo, the man who ordered the Uchiha clan massacre.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Hokage's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Sasuke faces off against the Raikage, the leader of the Hidden Cloud Village. The Raikage is a powerful ninja who can use lightning chakra.

Episodes.Title: The Key to the Future
Episodes.Description: Sasuke is defeated by the Raikage, but he is saved by Tobi, the true leader of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Tobi reveals his true identity. He is Obito Uchiha, Kakashi's former teammate.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Great Ninja War
Episodes.Description: Tobi declares war on the five great ninja villages. He plans to use the ten-tailed beast to create a new world.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage's Decision
Episodes.Description: The five great ninja villages form an alliance to fight the Akatsuki. The Fourth Great Ninja War begins.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Mist
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins his training to control the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. He is helped by Killer Bee, the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist
Episodes.Description: The Fourth Great Ninja War begins. The allied shinobi forces face off against the Akatsuki's army of reanimated ninja.

Episodes.Title: The User of the Scorch Style
Episodes.Description: The allied shinobi forces are struggling to fight the reanimated ninja. They are outnumbered and outmatched.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of the Puppet Master
Episodes.Description: Kankuro faces off against Sasori, who has been reanimated by Kabuto. Kankuro must use his skills as a puppet master to defeat him.

Episodes.Title: The Two Suns
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee join the battle. They are the allied shinobi forces' secret weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Unsetting Sun
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee face off against the reanimated jinchuriki. They must work together to defeat them.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a God
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee defeat the reanimated jinchuriki. They now have to face Tobi and the reanimated Madara Uchiha.

Episodes.Title: The Ten-Tails' Revival
Episodes.Description: Tobi and Madara revive the Ten-Tailed Beast. The allied shinobi forces are in for the fight of their lives.

Episodes.Title: The Infinite Tsukuyomi
Episodes.Description: Madara activates the Infinite Tsukuyomi. The entire world is trapped in a dream.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke are the only ones who can stop Madara. They must work together to save the world.

Episodes.Title: The New Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke defeat Madara. Naruto becomes the Seventh Hokage.

Episodes.Title: A New Threat
Episodes.Description: A new enemy appears, threatening the peace that Naruto has worked so hard to achieve.

Episodes.Title: The Next Generation
Episodes.Description: Naruto's son, Boruto, begins his own journey as a ninja. He is determined to surpass his father.

Episodes.Title: A New Mission
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his team are sent on their first mission. They must protect a village from a group of bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Chunin Exams
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends participate in the Chunin Exams. They must prove their strength and skill to become chunin.

Episodes.Title: The Otsutsuki Invasion
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exams are interrupted by Momoshiki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki, two powerful beings from another dimension.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage vs. Momoshiki
Episodes.Description: Naruto and the other Kage fight Momoshiki and Kinshiki. They are no match for their power.

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Sasuke
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke team up to fight Momoshiki. They must work together to save Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto defeats Momoshiki with a giant Rasengan. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Path to the Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and his friends looking forward to the future. They are the next generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: A New Beginning
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are now genin and they are sent on their first official mission.

Episodes.Title: The Byakuya Gang
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends must stop a group of thieves who are stealing from the rich and giving to the poor.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Incident
Episodes.Description: A mysterious ghost is causing trouble in the Hidden Leaf Village. Boruto and his friends must find a way to stop it.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Forest
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to a cursed forest. They must find a way to break the curse.

Episodes.Title: The Genin Exchange Program
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends travel to the Hidden Mist Village as part of a genin exchange program.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, Again!
Episodes.Description: The new Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist appear and they are not friendly.

Episodes.Title: The Jougan
Episodes.Description: Boruto awakens a mysterious power in his right eye. It is called the Jougan.

Episodes.Title: The Kara
Episodes.Description: A new organization called Kara appears. They are a mysterious group with a dark agenda.

Episodes.Title: The Vessel
Episodes.Description: Kara is looking for a vessel to house their leader, Jigen. They believe that Boruto is the perfect candidate.

Episodes.Title: The Karma
Episodes.Description: Boruto is marked with a mysterious seal called Karma. It gives him immense power, but it also has a dark side.

Episodes.Title: The Mujina Bandits
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his team are sent on a mission to the Land of Silence. They must protect a feudal lord from a group of bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Cloud, The Hidden Stone, The Hidden Mist
Episodes.Description: The other great ninja villages send their own teams to help Boruto. They must work together to defeat the Mujina Bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Ao Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to the Land of Water. They must investigate a mysterious airship.

Episodes.Title: The Scientific Ninja Tool
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends discover that the airship is a scientific ninja tool created by Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Value of a Shinobi
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends must decide whether to use scientific ninja tools. They are powerful, but they go against the traditions of the shinobi.

Episodes.Title: The Time for a Decision
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends decide to use scientific ninja tools to fight Kara. They are determined to protect the world from their evil plans.

Episodes.Title: The Kawaki Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. A mysterious boy named Kawaki appears. He has a Karma seal, just like Boruto.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Kawaki was raised by Jigen, the leader of Kara. He was abused and experimented on.

Episodes.Title: The Escape
Episodes.Description: Kawaki escapes from Kara and is found by Boruto and his friends. They take him to the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: The New Life
Episodes.Description: Kawaki begins his new life in the Hidden Leaf Village. He is taken in by Naruto and his family.

Episodes.Title: The Brother
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Kawaki do not get along at first, but they eventually become like brothers.

Episodes.Title: The Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins to train Kawaki. He teaches him how to control his Karma.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Kara attacks the Hidden Leaf Village to retrieve Kawaki. Naruto must protect him.

Episodes.Title: The Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Naruto sacrifices himself to save Kawaki. He is sealed away by Jigen.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue
Episodes.Description: Boruto, Kawaki, and their friends go to rescue Naruto. They must face Jigen and the other members of Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends defeat Jigen and rescue Naruto. They have saved the world once again.

Episodes.Title: The Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and Kawaki looking forward to the future. They are the new generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: Kakashi's Story: A Life on the Battlefield
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Kakashi's life.

Episodes.Title: Itachi's Story: Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Itachi's life.

Episodes.Title: Sasuke's Story: Sunrise
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Sasuke's life.

Episodes.Title: Shikamaru's Story: A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Shikamaru's life.

Episodes.Title: Konoha's Story: A Perfect Day for a Wedding
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Naruto and Hinata's wedding.

Episodes.Title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
Episodes.Description: The final movie in the Naruto series. Naruto must save Hinata from a new enemy who wants to destroy the world.

Episodes.Title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
Episodes.Description: The first movie in the Boruto series. Boruto must prove his strength to his father, Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Day Naruto Became Hokage
Episodes.Description: A special episode that shows the day Naruto became Hokage.

Episodes.Title: Road to Boruto
Episodes.Description: A special episode that recaps the events of Boruto: Naruto the Movie.

Episodes.Title: The Steam Ninja Scrolls
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Mirai Sarutobi, the granddaughter of the Third Hokage, is sent on a mission to a hot spring.

Episodes.Title: The Haunted Inn
Episodes.Description: Mirai must investigate a haunted inn. She is helped by Kakashi and Guy.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Ghost
Episodes.Description: Mirai discovers that the haunted inn is not haunted by a ghost, but by a cursed ninja.

Episodes.Title: The Final Mission
Episodes.Description: Mirai defeats the cursed ninja and completes her mission. She has proven herself to be a capable ninja.

Episodes.Title: The One-Tails' Escort
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to escort the One-Tailed Shukaku to the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: The Puppet Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends are attacked by a group of puppet masters. They must use their skills to defeat them.

Episodes.Title: Urashiki's Return
Episodes.Description: Urashiki Otsutsuki returns. He is looking for the One-Tailed Shukaku.

Episodes.Title: The Time-Traveling Turtle
Episodes.Description: Urashiki uses a time-traveling turtle to go back in time. Boruto and Sasuke follow him.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke travel to the past and meet a young Naruto. They must protect him from Urashiki.

Episodes.Title: The Jiraiya Connection
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke meet Jiraiya. They ask him to help them protect Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto, Sasuke, Naruto, and Jiraiya face off against Urashiki. They must work together to defeat him.

Episodes.Title: The Future
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke return to the future. They have saved the past and the future.

Episodes.Title: The Kara Actuation Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Kara begins to make its move. They are looking for a vessel for their leader, Jigen.

Episodes.Title: The Vessel
Episodes.Description: Kara finds a potential vessel in a young boy named Kawaki. He has a Karma seal, just like Boruto.

Episodes.Title: The Escape
Episodes.Description: Kawaki escapes from Kara and is found by Boruto and his friends. They take him to the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: The New Life

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Two and a half years have passed since the end of the original series. Naruto returns to the Hidden Leaf Village and reunites with his friends.

Episodes.Title: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki, a mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, begins to make its move. Their goal is to capture all of the tailed beasts.

Episodes.Title: The Results of Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sakura are tested by Kakashi to see how much they have grown. They must take two bells from him, just like they did when they were genin.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Sand
Episodes.Description: Gaara, the Kazekage of the Hidden Sand Village, is targeted by the Akatsuki. Deidara, a member of the Akatsuki, is sent to capture him.

Episodes.Title: The Kazekage Stands Tall
Episodes.Description: Gaara fights Deidara to protect his village. He is a powerful ninja, but Deidara has a few tricks up his sleeve.

Episodes.Title: Mission Cleared
Episodes.Description: Deidara captures Gaara and takes him to the Akatsuki hideout. The Hidden Sand Village is in turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Run, Kankuro
Episodes.Description: Kankuro goes after Deidara to rescue Gaara. He is a skilled puppet master, but he is no match for Sasori, another member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: Team Kakashi, Deployed
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi is sent to the Hidden Sand Village to help. They are the only ones who can save Gaara.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Tears
Episodes.Description: Sakura heals Kankuro, who was poisoned by Sasori. She is a skilled medical ninja.

Episodes.Title: Sealing Jutsu: Nine Phantom Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki begin the process of extracting the One-Tailed Shukaku from Gaara. The process will kill him.

Episodes.Title: The Medical Ninja's Student
Episodes.Description: Team Guy arrives to help Team Kakashi. They are a powerful team of taijutsu specialists.

Episodes.Title: The Retired Granny's Determination
Episodes.Description: Chiyo, a retired ninja from the Hidden Sand Village, decides to help Team Kakashi. She is a skilled puppet master and Sasori's grandmother.

Episodes.Title: A Fateful Encounter
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi and Team Guy arrive at the Akatsuki hideout. They are confronted by Itachi Uchiha and Kisame Hoshigaki.

Episodes.Title: Naruto's Growth
Episodes.Description: Kakashi faces off against Itachi. He is a powerful ninja, but Itachi's Mangekyo Sharingan is too much for him.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Weapon is Called...
Episodes.Description: Naruto uses his new jutsu, the Giant Rasengan, to defeat Itachi's clone.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Jinchuriki
Episodes.Description: Team Guy faces off against Kisame. They are powerful taijutsu specialists, but Kisame's Samehada is a dangerous weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Death of Gaara!
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki successfully extract the One-Tailed Shukaku from Gaara. Gaara dies.

Episodes.Title: Charge Tactic! Button Hook Entry!!
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi and Team Guy break into the Akatsuki hideout. They are confronted by Sasori and Deidara.

Episodes.Title: Traps Activate! Team Guy's Enemies
Episodes.Description: Team Guy is separated from Team Kakashi and forced to fight clones of themselves.

Episodes.Title: Hiruko vs. Two Kunoichi!
Episodes.Description: Sakura and Chiyo face off against Sasori in his Hiruko puppet.

Episodes.Title: The True Face of Sasori
Episodes.Description: Sakura destroys the Hiruko puppet, revealing Sasori's true form. He is a young man who has turned himself into a human puppet.

Episodes.Title: Chiyo's Secret Skills
Episodes.Description: Chiyo reveals her own puppets, the Mother and Father puppets. They were created to look like Sasori's parents.

Episodes.Title: Father and Mother
Episodes.Description: Sasori reveals his most powerful puppet, the Third Kazekage. The Third Kazekage was a powerful ninja who could control iron sand.

Episodes.Title: The Third Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Sakura and Chiyo struggle to fight the Third Kazekage puppet. Sakura comes up with a plan to defeat it.

Episodes.Title: Three Minutes Between Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Sakura is poisoned by Sasori's puppet. Chiyo must use a forbidden jutsu to save her.

Episodes.Title: Puppet Fight: 10 vs. 100!
Episodes.Description: Chiyo summons ten of her own puppets to fight Sasori's one hundred puppets.

Episodes.Title: Impossible Dream
Episodes.Description: Sasori is defeated by Sakura and Chiyo. He dies in the arms of his Mother and Father puppets.

Episodes.Title: Beasts: Alive Again!
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Kakashi chase after Deidara, who has Gaara's body. Deidara uses his explosive clay to create a diversion.

Episodes.Title: Kakashi Enlightened!
Episodes.Description: Kakashi awakens his Mangekyo Sharingan. He uses it to send Deidara's arm to another dimension.

Episodes.Title: Aesthetics of an Instant
Episodes.Description: Naruto uses the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox to defeat Deidara. Deidara escapes, but he leaves Gaara's body behind.

Episodes.Title: The Legacy
Episodes.Description: Chiyo uses a forbidden jutsu to bring Gaara back to life. She sacrifices her own life in the process.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Gaara returns to the Hidden Sand Village as a hero. He has finally been accepted by his people.

Episodes.Title: The New Target
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Team Kakashi gets a new member, Sai. They are sent on a mission to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Formation! New Team Kakashi
Episodes.Description: Sai is a mysterious ninja who has no emotions. He is a member of Root, a secret organization within the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: An Unnecessary Addition
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sai do not get along. They are constantly fighting.

Episodes.Title: The Fake Smile
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi sets out on their mission. They are led by Yamato, a ninja who can control wood.

Episodes.Title: Untitled
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi arrives at the Tenchi Bridge, where they are supposed to meet one of Sasori's spies.

Episodes.Title: The Fruits of Training
Episodes.Description: The spy turns out to be Kabuto, Orochimaru's right-hand man. Orochimaru appears and a battle ensues.

Episodes.Title: The Nine-Tails Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Naruto loses control and unleashes the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox. He grows four tails and becomes a miniature version of the beast.

Episodes.Title: The Top-Secret Mission Begins
Episodes.Description: Yamato uses his wood style to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. Naruto returns to normal, but he is badly injured.

Episodes.Title: Orochimaru's Hideout
Episodes.Description: Sai reveals that he has been working for Danzo, a rogue elder of the Hidden Leaf Village. He has been ordered to kill Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Bond
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi infiltrates Orochimaru's hideout. They are determined to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Sakura's Tears
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi finds Sasuke, but he is not the same person they once knew. He is cold and distant.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Battle
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks Team Kakashi. He is more powerful than ever before.

Episodes.Title: The Consequences of Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke face off. Their battle is interrupted by Orochimaru and Kabuto.

Episodes.Title: The Unfinished Page
Episodes.Description: Sai has a change of heart and decides to help Team Kakashi. He wants to understand the meaning of friendship.

Episodes.Title: Infiltration! The Den of the Snake!
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi returns to the Hidden Leaf Village. Their mission was a failure, but they have not given up on Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Bonds
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Naruto begins his training to create a new jutsu. He must learn to combine his wind chakra with the Rasengan.

Episodes.Title: Something Important...
Episodes.Description: Asuma Sarutobi, the leader of Team 10, is killed by Hidan, a member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Picture Book's Story
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru is devastated by Asuma's death. He vows to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Team 10, led by Kakashi, goes after Hidan and Kakuzu, another member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Power of the Uchiha
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru uses his intelligence to defeat Hidan. He traps him in a pit and buries him alive.

Episodes.Title: Title
Episodes.Description: Naruto arrives to help Kakashi fight Kakuzu. He has perfected his new jutsu, the Rasenshuriken.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Kakuzu with his Rasenshuriken. The jutsu is powerful, but it also damages Naruto's arm.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The Akatsuki's leader, Pain, begins his plan to capture the Nine-Tailed Fox.

Episodes.Title: Writhe
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village to gather information on Pain. He is confronted by Konan, a former student.

Episodes.Title: Deprived of Sleep
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya faces off against Pain. Pain has the Rinnegan, a powerful dojutsu that was once possessed by the Sage of Six Paths.

Episodes.Title: Loneliness
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya is killed by Pain. He dies with a smile on his face, knowing that he has found the child of prophecy.

Episodes.Title: A New Enemy
Episodes.Description: Pain attacks the Hidden Leaf Village. He is looking for Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Description: The ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village fight back against Pain. They are no match for his power.

Episodes.Title: The Forbidden Jutsu
Episodes.Description: Kakashi is killed by Pain. He dies protecting the village.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Naruto returns to the village and finds it in ruins. He is devastated by the destruction.

Episodes.Title: The Triumphant Return
Episodes.Description: Naruto faces off against Pain. He has mastered Sage Mode, a powerful technique that allows him to use natural energy.

Episodes.Title: The Sixth Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Pain and saves the village. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage Summit
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The leaders of the five great ninja villages meet to discuss the threat of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Man Named Kisame
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks the Five Kage Summit. He is looking for Danzo, the man who ordered the Uchiha clan massacre.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Hokage's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Sasuke faces off against the Raikage, the leader of the Hidden Cloud Village. The Raikage is a powerful ninja who can use lightning chakra.

Episodes.Title: The Key to the Future
Episodes.Description: Sasuke is defeated by the Raikage, but he is saved by Tobi, the true leader of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Tobi reveals his true identity. He is Obito Uchiha, Kakashi's former teammate.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Great Ninja War
Episodes.Description: Tobi declares war on the five great ninja villages. He plans to use the ten-tailed beast to create a new world.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage's Decision
Episodes.Description: The five great ninja villages form an alliance to fight the Akatsuki. The Fourth Great Ninja War begins.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Mist
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins his training to control the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. He is helped by Killer Bee, the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist
Episodes.Description: The Fourth Great Ninja War begins. The allied shinobi forces face off against the Akatsuki's army of reanimated ninja.

Episodes.Title: The User of the Scorch Style
Episodes.Description: The allied shinobi forces are struggling to fight the reanimated ninja. They are outnumbered and outmatched.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of the Puppet Master
Episodes.Description: Kankuro faces off against Sasori, who has been reanimated by Kabuto. Kankuro must use his skills as a puppet master to defeat him.

Episodes.Title: The Two Suns
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee join the battle. They are the allied shinobi forces' secret weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Unsetting Sun
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee face off against the reanimated jinchuriki. They must work together to defeat them.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a God
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee defeat the reanimated jinchuriki. They now have to face Tobi and the reanimated Madara Uchiha.

Episodes.Title: The Ten-Tails' Revival
Episodes.Description: Tobi and Madara revive the Ten-Tailed Beast. The allied shinobi forces are in for the fight of their lives.

Episodes.Title: The Infinite Tsukuyomi
Episodes.Description: Madara activates the Infinite Tsukuyomi. The entire world is trapped in a dream.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke are the only ones who can stop Madara. They must work together to save the world.

Episodes.Title: The New Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke defeat Madara. Naruto becomes the Seventh Hokage.

Episodes.Title: A New Threat
Episodes.Description: A new enemy appears, threatening the peace that Naruto has worked so hard to achieve.

Episodes.Title: The Next Generation
Episodes.Description: Naruto's son, Boruto, begins his own journey as a ninja. He is determined to surpass his father.

Episodes.Title: A New Mission
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his team are sent on their first mission. They must protect a village from a group of bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Chunin Exams
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends participate in the Chunin Exams. They must prove their strength and skill to become chunin.

Episodes.Title: The Otsutsuki Invasion
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exams are interrupted by Momoshiki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki, two powerful beings from another dimension.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage vs. Momoshiki
Episodes.Description: Naruto and the other Kage fight Momoshiki and Kinshiki. They are no match for their power.

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Sasuke
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke team up to fight Momoshiki. They must work together to save Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto defeats Momoshiki with a giant Rasengan. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Path to the Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and his friends looking forward to the future. They are the next generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Forest

Episodes.Title: The Kara
Episodes.Description: A new organization called Kara appears. They are a mysterious group with a dark agenda.

Episodes.Title: The Vessel
Episodes.Description: Kara is looking for a vessel to house their leader, Jigen. They believe that Boruto is the perfect candidate.

Episodes.Title: The Karma
Episodes.Description: Boruto is marked with a mysterious seal called Karma. It gives him immense power, but it also has a dark side.

Episodes.Description: The other great ninja villages send their own teams to help Boruto. They must work together to defeat the Mujina Bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Ao Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to the Land of Water. They must investigate a mysterious airship.

Episodes.Title: The Scientific Ninja Tool
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends discover that the airship is a scientific ninja tool created by Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Value of a Shinobi
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends must decide whether to use scientific ninja tools. They are powerful, but they go against the traditions of the shinobi.

Episodes.Title: The Time for a Decision
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends decide to use scientific ninja tools to fight Kara. They are determined to protect the world from their evil plans.

Episodes.Title: The Kawaki Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. A mysterious boy named Kawaki appears. He has a Karma seal, just like Boruto.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Kawaki was raised by Jigen, the leader of Kara. He was abused and experimented on.

Episodes.Title: The Escape
Episodes.Description: Kawaki escapes from Kara and is found by Boruto and his friends. They take him to the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: The New Life
Episodes.Description: Kawaki begins his new life in the Hidden Leaf Village. He is taken in by Naruto and his family.

Episodes.Title: The Brother
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Kawaki do not get along at first, but they eventually become like brothers.

Episodes.Title: The Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins to train Kawaki. He teaches him how to control his Karma.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Kara attacks the Hidden Leaf Village to retrieve Kawaki. Naruto must protect him.

Episodes.Title: The Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Naruto sacrifices himself to save Kawaki. He is sealed away by Jigen.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue
Episodes.Description: Boruto, Kawaki, and their friends go to rescue Naruto. They must face Jigen and the other members of Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends defeat Jigen and rescue Naruto. They have saved the world once again.

Episodes.Title: The Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and Kawaki looking forward to the future. They are the new generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: The New Target
Episodes.Description: Teams Kakashi and Guy return home to Konoha. As Kakashi rests in the infirmary, Sakura tells Tsunade about the information Sasori gave her as a reward for defeating him. Sasori had a meeting scheduled with a spy from within Orochimaru's ranks in 10 days. 4 days have passed since Sakura received this information, and now Naruto and Sakura need to recruit a new team member to go and investigate. As Naruto searches Konoha for a willing recruit, he meets some of his old friends. Just as Choji agrees to help, Shikamaru, Choji, and Naruto are attacked by a Konoha shinobi unknown to them, Sai.

Episodes.Title: Formation! New Team Kakashi
Episodes.Description: Naruto, Choji and Shikamaru attempt to capture and interrogate Sai, but Sai withdraws after insulting Naruto. Shortly afterward, Ino appears. Concerned that the demon fox could fall into Akatsuki hands, the village elders challenge Tsunade's plan to send Naruto out of the village without the still bedridden Kakashi. Tsunade promises to protect Konoha with her own life if Naruto is captured, but is still forced to compromise with Danzo by adding Sai to Team Kakashi. She also temporarily replaces Kakashi with ANBU member Yamato and warns him to keep an eye on Sai. Naruto and Sakura finally meet their new team members, and Naruto is immediately angered upon Sai's appearance.

Episodes.Title: An Unneeded Addition
Episodes.Description: Yamato takes temporary leadership of Team Kakashi while Sai insults both Naruto and Sakura. While preparing to set off, Sai receives an envelope from a Root shinobi containing secret orders from Danzo, and Sakura consults with Tsunade. Jiraiya then meets with Tsunade and Yamato in Kakashi's hospital room to brief Yamato on the demon fox within Naruto, detailing the "demon fox's cloak", and revealing a scar he got from Naruto when the fourth tail formed. Finally the new Team Kakashi set off on their new mission, to intercept an Akatsuki spy and gather information about Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: The Fake Smile
Episodes.Description: The new team Kakashi heads out for the Heaven and Earth bridge. Sai, Sakura, and Naruto come to blows after just 5 minutes on the same team due to Sai making fun of Sasuke. Therefore, Yamato decides they need to improve on teamwork and uses Mokuton to create a wooden cage threatening to lock the team up unless they behave. Given an ultimatum between being locked up or spending the night at a hot springs, the team chooses to visit the springs to improve team cohesion. Naruto still despises Sai despite this effort, and several insulting remarks from Sai worsen team relations.

Episodes.Title: Untitled
Episodes.Description: Sakura sees Sai drawing by the river and finds out that Sai has artistic talent but has never given titles to anything he ever drew. Naruto and Sakura begin to realize the reason behind Sai's repulsive personality. After the hot springs, the team heads off to the bridge to meet the spy. Yamato is suspicious of traps so they go off the main road into the forest. Camping for the night, Yamato then creates a two story house by again using his Mokuton jutsu. Inside this house, the team formulates their plan.

Episodes.Title: Simulation
Episodes.Description: Naruto is paired with Sai for the Buddy team of two, over his and Sakura's objections, while Sakura is assigned to support Yamato. Yamato conducts a simulation of the spy meeting with himself as the spy to gauge Naruto and Sai's abilities and teamwork. After Naruto makes a mistake when attacking Yamato, Sai immobilizes him and goes on to capture Yamato alone. Naruto is angry with Sai for not acting as a comrade would, but resolves to work together with him if doing so will help bring Sasuke back. Sai reveals to Sakura that he has no emotions, and little understanding of them. The group then prepares to head to the bridge.

Episodes.Title: The Tenchi Bridge
Episodes.Description: Yamato disguises himself as Sasori after creating a wood replica of Hiruko, and goes to meet the spy. The spy turns out to be Orochimaru's right-hand man, Kabuto Yakushi, who reveals the location of Orochimaru's current hideout to Yamato. Orochimaru interrupts the meeting, appearing to attack Kabuto, and while it initially appears that Orochimaru has come after Kabuto, Kabuto attacks Yamato and reveals that he is truly loyal to Orochimaru. Orochimaru calls out Naruto, Sakura and Sai from where they are hiding and observing the meeting, and prepares to fight the team.

Episodes.Title: The Nine-Tails Unleashed!!
Episodes.Description: Immediately after Yamato signals Naruto and the others out to the bridge where Orochimaru and Kabuto are waiting, Naruto's chakra begins to boil with the chakra of the Nine-Tailed Fox. Slowly, Naruto grows more tails as Orochimaru taunts him and makes him even more angry. Meanwhile, Yamato remembers Jiraiya speaking of how many tails he has seen Naruto grow. Jiraiya explains more about what happened and more about how Naruto acts when he's in his Nine-Tails form.

Episodes.Title: The Top-Secret Mission Begins
Episodes.Description: Naruto continues to get even more enraged and easily counters Kabuto's attack, flinging him away. Naruto's counter throws Kabuto into Sakura, knocking her unconscious. Orochimaru continues to watch Naruto become more enraged, eventually destroying the Bridge of Heaven and Earth. As the bridge collapses, Sakura slides off the edge. Sai draws a bird to fly, but chooses to follow Naruto and Orochimaru instead of saving Sakura. Yamato saves her at the last second, and creates a wood clone to catch up to the battle. Eventually the fourth tail appears, allowing the vile chakra to completely control Naruto's body, forming him into a miniature Nine-Tailed Fox.

Episodes.Title: Orochimaru vs. Jinchuriki
Episodes.Description: Naruto, in the four-tailed state, begins attacking Orochimaru with incredible force, devastating the surrounding landscape and preventing Sai and Yamato's wood clone from approaching him. The majority of Orochimaru's attacks prove to be ineffective, but Naruto also fails to kill Orochimaru as he regenerates from any injuries he sustains. Meanwhile, Kabuto advances toward Sakura and Yamato, deducing that Sasori has died. Orochimaru finally manages to strike Naruto with a sword blade from his mouth, and Sakura reacts in horror when she sees Naruto's four-tailed state.

Episodes.Title: Sakura's Tears
Episodes.Description: Kabuto comments that Naruto's state is a consequence of his desperation to bring back Sasuke. Sakura begins to cry and approaches Naruto but is injured when his attention turns to her. Yamato uses the mokuton jutsu to bind Naruto before he does any more harm. Kabuto heals Sakura, reasoning that the Konoha ninja are not Orochimaru's enemies because they are also fighting Akatsuki. Yamato uses the abilities of the 1st Hokage to forcibly return Naruto to his normal state. Meanwhile Sai confronts Orochimaru with a message from Danzo. Orochimaru responds by piercing Sai with Kusanagi.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Battle!
Episodes.Description: Yamato uses the first Hokage's chakra to suppress the demon fox's chakra and Naruto returns to normal, but with severe injuries. Sakura begins to heal him, but notes that medical ninjutsu has little effect on his wounds. Orochimaru's sword is revealed to have only pierced one of Sai's clones. The real Sai emerges, talks to Orochimaru and gives him a letter from Danzo. Sai then leaves with Orochimaru and Kabuto but Yamato's wood clone stays close on their trail. Naruto comes to his senses and wonders what happened but Sakura decides not to tell him the truth. They reach the meeting spot, picking up the picture book Sai left behind. Yamato infers that Danzo seeks to destroy and remake Konoha by collaborating with Orochimaru.

Episodes.Title: The Consequences of Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Kabuto creates a fake corpse that resembles Sai, containing hidden traps to slow down Yamato's clone after sensing it. Naruto hasn't completely recovered from using the Demon Fox's chakra, and Yamato says that he will be left behind if he cannot keep up. Naruto is determined to finish his mission and not slow the team down. However Team Kakashi is forced to take a break when it's clear that Sakura has not fully recovered from her own injuries. Yamato then uses this opportunity to talk to Naruto alone and reveals to him that the one who hurt Sakura was Naruto himself. Naruto is shocked by what Yamato says to him.

Episodes.Title: The Unfinished Page
Episodes.Description: Naruto finally makes sense of the destruction he witnessed around him earlier. Yamato tells Naruto not to rely on the demon because Naruto is strong enough to withstand the demon's terrible chakra. Sai discovers the loss of his book while resting. Team Kakashi browse Sai's book, and they notice that the book (which can be read from both ends) contains different paths of two boys who meet in the middle. Each page has the boys fighting someone new, each time collecting the opponent's armor and weapons into the next page. The pages where the two boys would meet are unfinished. Orochimaru's group reach their base, not realizing that Yamato's wood clone trailed them there. Sai gets a glimpse of Sasuke's silhouette and eyes and discovers that he is the man Naruto and Sakura are looking for.

Episodes.Title: Infiltration: The Den of the Snake!
Episodes.Description: Sai receives a chilling glare from Sasuke's Sharingan that frightens him. Sai gives Orochimaru a bundle with information about Konoha's ANBU. Yamato gives Sakura and Naruto seeds with his chakra that enables him to track them inside the lair, and reveals that he was able to track Sai because he put a seed in Sai's clothing and food during the visit to the hot springs. Kabuto locks Sai in a room, and the boy summons a bingo book from scrolls he carries. Yamato uses a jutsu to open a tunnel into Orochimaru's hideout, and he, Naruto and Sakura travel to Sai's room undetected.

Episodes.Title: Bonds
Episodes.Description: Yamato and the team enter Sai's room and confront him while Kabuto makes his way there as well. Sai tells Team Kakashi that not only was he to help with Konoha's destruction but also act as a spy against Orochimaru. Yamato reveals the secret of "Root"- its members were trained like Kirigakure's students in that they had to kill their friends so as to eliminate their emotions. Sakura returns Sai's book to him, remarking that he still has emotions because he treasures it. Sai then tells the group about his bond with his brother. Finally the team decides what to do about Sai's betrayal outside the lair. In doing so, Naruto tells the group about his own bonds and about how far he's willing to go to bring Sasuke back.

Episodes.Title: Something Important...
Episodes.Description: Kabuto fights Team Kakashi and frees Sai. However, Sai, who intends to learn more about his bond with his brother through Naruto's bond with Sasuke, betrays him. Captured, Kabuto gives a vague description of Sasuke's location to the team. Leaving Yamato's wood clone to watch over Kabuto, Team Kakashi enters Orochimaru's hideout and splits up to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: The Picture Book's Story
Episodes.Description: As Team Kakashi continues their search for Sasuke, Naruto suddenly collapses due to his previous fight with Orochimaru. As Naruto wakes up, Sai begins to reveal more about his brother, but Orochimaru suddenly attacks them. Sakura and Yamato come to Naruto's aid against Orochimaru, while Sai continues the search. Just as Sai finds Sasuke, Yamato finds Sai's bingo book with Sasuke listed as a target for assassination.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: As Team Kakashi continues their search for Sasuke, Sai approaches Sasuke's room and awakens him. Shaken by the image of Sasuke's Sharingan from earlier, Sai attempts to restrain him. A large explosion occurs and Sakura, Naruto and Yamato catch up. At first Sakura tries to restrain Sai in order to find out his true objective, but she stops, stunned at seeing her former comrade. Contrary to what the rest of the team assumed to be his mission, Sai tells them that he wishes to bring Sasuke back to Konoha.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Uchiha
Episodes.Description: Sasuke begins to attack Naruto, but Sai restrains him only for them both to be blown away by Sasuke's Chidori Nagashi. Sakura charges at Sasuke, but Yamato intervenes and winds up being stabbed by Sasuke's unique blade infused with his Chidori. The Nine-Tailed Fox tempts Naruto with its power, but he refuses it. Sasuke sees this using his Sharingan, appearing in Naruto's mind. The Nine-Tails says that Sasuke's chakra reminds him of Madara Uchiha, then Sasuke suppresses the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. Before the Nine-Tailed Fox returns to its cage, it warns Sasuke not to kill Naruto, saying that he will live to regret it forever.

Episodes.Title: The Leaves Sprout!
Episodes.Description: Orochimaru and Kabuto convince Sasuke to withdraw with them, and Naruto weeps over his failure to return Sasuke to the village, but Sakura reassures him that they will bring Sasuke back together. Naruto's team reports to Tsunade about the results of the mission, and Tsunade is greatly angered over Danzo's scheme, particularly his leaking classified information to further it. Sai asks Danzo to allow him to remain with Team Kakashi, and Danzo reluctantly agrees. Sai goes on a mission with his team, having come to see them as his friends.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Naruto's been having nightmares about the release of the Nine-Tail's power. Afterward, Kakashi informs Naruto that he has special training for him that will make him strong quickly. They are cut off by Team 10, who have also come to visit. Sai lunches with them and, trying to make friends by using nicknames, angers Sakura by calling Ino "gorgeous" after concluding that women do not like to hear how they really are.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: Kakashi is released from the hospital and begins Naruto's training program. Naruto learns that he has Wind-style chakra. Yamato helps by setting up the training field with his special jutsu. Naruto also learns that he can use his Multi Shadow Clone jutsu to speed up his training, since whatever the clones learn, the original user learns upon the clone's dispersal. Naruto and his mass of clones each take a leaf and attempt to slice it in half with wind chakra as the first step to creating his new jutsu.

Episodes.Title: Writhe
Episodes.Description: Naruto and his clones continue to work on chakra nature manipulation by slicing leaves. After some struggling, Naruto approaches Asuma, who is also a wind type, for advice, after which Asuma gives Naruto's clone a few pointers. Naruto is subsequently able to slice a leaf in half. Asuma and Yamato head out with their teams on new missions. It is revealed that Asuma is the Third Hokage's son and that he is in a relationship with Kurenai. Meanwhile, on a hill overlooking a burnt village, four cloaked figures discuss the awakening of the Fire Country by eliminating the Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: Deprived of Eternal Sleep
Episodes.Description: Naruto, Sakura, Sai and Yamato head out for a new mission near the Fire Temple. When the other party fails to show up at the rendezvous point, the team gets separated and Naruto stumbles upon one of the four hidden tombs they came to protect. Due to a misunderstanding, he fights one of the monks-in-training from the Fire Temple, Sora, who also uses wind chakra based techniques. After the confusion, the monks and Team Kakashi travel to the Fire Temple, and Naruto recognizes it from his nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Loneliness
Episodes.Description: The temple monks explain that the tombs hold the loyal bodyguards of Fire Country's feudal lord. Naruto observes Sora sparring with other monks and becomes offended upon realizing he is holding back. Naruto challenges Sora, but just as the matter is about to get serious, another monk stops him. Naruto realizes Sora is despised by the other monks as he was himself and wishes to befriend him. Naruto visits Sora again and observes him practicing his wind jutsu in earnest, hoping to get strong enough to avenge his father. They later return to the temple to receive news that another tomb has been robbed.

Episodes.Title: A New Enemy
Episodes.Description: Tsunade suspects that Danzou is plotting something and orders an investigation of him. Team Kakashi, Chiriku and Sora notice the coffins moving on their own, but fail to intercept them. The coffins emerge on a cliff, where the leader of the enemy ninja orders his subordinates to deal with their foes. The ninjas turn the area into a maze of rocky canyons and pits, full of deadly traps. The team members are separated from each other, and begin facing off against the enemy. Yamato speculates that the ninja may have orchestrated the theft in order to target someone on his team.

Episodes.Title: Impermanence
